Global (All).title: Iran Warns US of 'Harsh Response' Over Drone Seizure
Global (All).summary: Iran has threatened to take 'harsh' action against the US after a US drone entered Iranian airspace and was seized by the Iranian military. The incident has raised concerns about tensions between the two countries.

Global (All).title: Taliban Says 'No One Has the Right to Interfere in Afghanistan'
Biden Says 'No Decision' Made to Remove US Troops From Germany
Global (All).summary: US President Joe Biden has said that 'no decision' has been made to remove US troops from Germany. The announcement comes after reports that the US was considering withdrawing troops from Germany amid increasing tensions with Russia.

United States.title: Texas Elementary School Shooting Leaves 18 Injured, Including 9 Students and 5 Adults, with 2 Others Missing - NBC News
United States.summary: In the third Texas elementary school shooting in as many months, an 18-year-old gunman opened fire at the school, injuring several people and leaving others missing

United States.title: Florida Police Officer Arrested for Fatally Shooting 27-Year-Old Man During Traffic Stop - NBC News
United States.summary: A Florida police officer has been arrested for fatally shooting a 27-year-old man during a traffic stop, which was captured on dashcam footage.

United States.title: Gunman Kills 1, Injures 4 at Oklahoma Elementary School Shooting - NBC News
United States.summary: An 18-year-old gunman went on a shooting rampage at an Oklahoma elementary school, killing one student and injuring four others before being apprehended by police.

details.Event 2: Anti-nuclear protests erupt in Osaka, Japan, ahead of a crucial vote on the country's nuclear energy policy, highlighting growing public discontent.
